leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a store object to manage application state
Initialize state with default values using a configuration object
Implement subscription methods to notify listeners of state changes
Manipulate store state through defined update functions
Apply reactive patterns by connecting state changes to UI updates
Configure multiple components to subscribe to the same store instance
Control subscription cleanup to prevent memory leaks
lessonTitle: Build tiny reactive store with subscriptions
